title: Authority, failover and recovery boundaries
invariants: LDAP Bind establishes authentication attribution; it is not by itself directory authorization.
Access control and exact method permission remain separate checks from authentication.
A logical peer is stable across replacement runtimes and transport/carrier changes.
Authority epoch fences writers after promotion; committed replay from sealed older epochs may remain recoverable while new stale writes fail closed.
Within one authority epoch the holder identity is immutable; a same-epoch holder substitution is rejected.
A promotion changes holder only by advancing authority epoch.
Directory semantic commit authority is independent of transport delivery evidence.
Instrumentation correlation is observation evidence only and grants neither commit nor promotion authority.

reject: same epoch with different authority holder
